name: Shining Saotome
original_name: シャイニング 早乙女
source:
Principal of the Saotome Academy and a famous idol in his youth. Thanks to his debut single he achieved his dreams to build a school to create new idols.
He has a strange and crazy behaviour, but he cares deeply about his students.
